commit.title: CI: also run the test data with 4 frame threads
commit.message:
CI: also run the test data with 4 frame threads

Add a --threads 4 --framedelay 4 run to the plain, ASan and TSan jobs.
The test data so far only ran with up to 2 threads (besides the samples
that set their own thread arguments).
